articles.title_cn: 稳健的最优宏观审慎政策
articles.abstract_en: We consider how fears of model misspecification on the part of the planner and/or the households affect welfare gains from optimal macroprudential taxes in an economy with occasionally binding collateral constraints. In this setup, the decentralized equilibrium may differ from the social planner's equilibrium both because of the pecuniary externalities associated with the collateral constraint and because of the paternalistic imposition of the planner's beliefs when designing policy. When robust agents have doubts about the model, they create endogenous worst-case beliefs by assigning a high probability to low-utility events. The ratio of worst-case beliefs of the planner over the household's captures the degree of paternalism. We show that this novel channel could render the directions of welfare gains from a policy intervention ambiguous. However, our quantitative results suggest that doubts about the model need to be large to make a “laissez-faire regime” better than an intervention regime.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑了规划者和/或家庭对模型错误设定的担忧如何影响在具有偶尔约束性的抵押品约束的经济中，最优宏观审慎税收的福利收益。在这种设定下，分散均衡可能与社会规划者的均衡不同，既因为与抵押品约束相关的金钱外部性，也因为设计政策时家长式地强加规划者的信念。当稳健主体对模型有疑虑时，他们通过赋予低效用事件高概率来产生内生的最坏情况信念。规划者相对于家庭的最坏情况信念比率捕捉了家长式干预的程度。我们表明，这一新颖渠道可能使政策干预的福利收益方向变得模糊。然而，我们的定量结果表明，要使“自由放任体制”优于干预体制，对模型的疑虑需要很大。

articles.title_en: Forecasting the U.S. Dollar in the 21st Century
articles.abstract_en: A long-standing puzzle is the near-random-walk behavior of exchange rates. Recent literature has proposed models to forecast exchange rates at medium- and long-horizons. Such tests suffer from small-sample bias but inferring the true test distribution is difficult. We propose two approaches to address the problem. First, since economists are interested in the value of economic models versus purely statistical models, we propose a horse-race that pits the economic models not against the random walk, but against the forecasts from the level of the exchange rate. These economic models are challenged because the level of the exchange rate appears to be a more powerful predictor than “global risk” variables. We also propose a second more general but less powerful test. But with both tests we demonstrate using bootstraps that the random walk cannot be rejected, so the predictive power of the lagged exchange rate and many other variables is illusory.
articles.abstract_cn: 一个长期存在的谜题是汇率的近似随机游走行为。最近的文献提出了在中期和长期预测汇率的模型。此类检验存在小样本偏差，但推断真实检验分布是困难的。我们提出两种方法来解决这个问题。首先，由于经济学家关注经济模型相对于纯统计模型的价值，我们提出一场竞赛，将经济模型不是与随机游走相比，而是与汇率水平的预测相比。这些经济模型受到挑战，因为汇率水平似乎比“全球风险”变量更具预测力。我们还提出了第二个更一般但功效较弱的检验。但通过这两种检验，我们使用自助法证明随机游走不能被拒绝，因此滞后汇率和许多其他变量的预测能力是虚幻的。

articles.title_en: Exchange rate risk, banks' currency mismatches, and credit supply
articles.title_cn: 汇率风险、银行货币错配与信贷供给
articles.abstract_en: We exploit the post-Brexit depreciation of the British pound as an exogenous shock to show how exchange rate shocks transmit to the German real economy through the banking sector. German banks with GBP currency mismatches (between assets and liabilities, including off-balance sheet items) suffer losses when the currency of assets depreciates relative to that of liabilities, which they internalize by cutting back credit supply. For a one percentage-point loss in equity, a bank cuts credit supply by 73 basis points on average, with stronger effects for banks with lower equity capital. The credit contraction of German banks (i) affects also firms that are not directly related to UK conditions, (ii) holds across all industries, including non-tradable sectors, (iii) impacts relatively more small borrowers, and (iv) decreases affected firms' investments.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用英国脱欧后英镑贬值作为外生冲击，展示汇率冲击如何通过银行部门传导至德国实体经济。拥有英镑货币错配（资产与负债之间，包括表外项目）的德国银行，在资产货币相对于负债货币贬值时遭受损失，它们通过削减信贷供给来内部化这些损失。对于每一百分点的股本损失，银行平均削减信贷供给73个基点，且对股本资本较低的银行影响更强。德国银行的信贷收缩（i）也影响与英国状况无直接关联的企业，（ii）在所有行业中都存在，包括非贸易部门，（iii）对小型借款人的影响相对更大，以及（iv）减少了受影响企业的投资。

articles.abstract_en: We highlight the key role of changes in the transportation and use of intermediate inputs in determining the CO2 consequences of reductions in trade barriers such as tariffs and transportation efficiency improvements. Reductions in trade barriers increase gross flows relative to value added – a lengthening of value chains – thereby increasing transportation emissions. Reductions in trade barriers also increase wages relative to the price of other goods, which increases the quantity of intermediates relative to labor used in production and, therefore, emissions per value added. Liberalization schemes that temper these channels could achieve substantial output increases with modest increases in CO2.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们强调了中间投入品的运输和使用变化在决定关税和运输效率改进等贸易壁垒减少的二氧化碳后果中的关键作用。贸易壁垒的减少增加了相对于增加值的总流量——即价值链的延长——从而增加了运输排放。贸易壁垒的减少也提高了相对于其他商品价格的工资，这增加了生产中使用的中间品相对于劳动的数量，因此增加了单位增加值的排放。缓和这些渠道的自由化方案可以在适度增加二氧化碳的情况下实现显著的产出增长。

articles.title_en: Risk sharing and the adoption of the Euro
articles.abstract_en: This paper empirically evaluates whether adopting a common currency has changed the level of consumption smoothing of euro area member states. We construct a counterfactual dataset of macroeconomic variables through the synthetic control method. We then use the output variance decomposition of Asdrubali et al. (1996) on both the actual and the synthetic data to study if there has been a change in risk sharing and through which channels. We find that the euro adoption has reduced risk sharing and consumption smoothing. We further show that this reduction is mainly driven by the periphery countries of the euro area who have experienced a decrease in risk sharing through private credit.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文实证评估了采用共同货币是否改变了欧元区成员国的消费平滑水平。我们通过合成控制法构建了一个反事实的宏观经济变量数据集。然后，我们使用Asdrubali等人（1996）的产出方差分解方法，对实际数据和合成数据进行分析，以研究风险分担是否发生变化以及通过哪些渠道发生变化。我们发现，欧元采用降低了风险分担和消费平滑。我们进一步表明，这种降低主要由欧元区外围国家驱动，这些国家通过私人信贷的风险分担有所减少。

articles.title_en: Sudden stops and optimal foreign exchange intervention
articles.abstract_en: We model sudden stops in a small open economy as rare discrete events precipitated by increases in the world risk-free rate. When external debt is large, the model exhibits multiple equilibria, one where external debt and consumption remain high, and one with a collapse in external debt and consumption. Private agents delever following an increase in the world interest rate, but they fail to internalize the impact of deleveraging on the price of collateral. For high levels of external debt, even a small increase in the world interest rate can eliminate the high debt equilibrium and the economy experiences a sudden stop. The central bank can use foreign exchange intervention to prevent the sudden stop. If reserves cannot be borrowed, optimal policy is to “lean against the wind”, buying foreign reserves ex-ante when private borrowing is high and selling them after an interest rate shock when private agents are deleveraging.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个小型开放经济中，将骤停建模为由世界无风险利率上升引发的罕见离散事件。当外部债务较大时，模型表现出多重均衡，一种是外部债务和消费保持高位的均衡，另一种是外部债务和消费崩溃的均衡。私人部门在世界利率上升后去杠杆，但他们未能内化去杠杆对抵押品价格的影响。对于高外部债务水平，即使世界利率小幅上升也可能消除高债务均衡，经济经历骤停。中央银行可以使用外汇干预来防止骤停。如果储备不能借入，最优政策是“逆风而行”，在私人借贷高时事前购买外汇储备，并在利率冲击后私人部门去杠杆时出售储备。

articles.title_en: Sudden stops and reserve accumulation in the presence of international liquidity risk
articles.title_cn: 国际流动性风险下的突然停止与储备积累
articles.abstract_en: We propose a small open economy model where agents borrow internationally and invest in liquid foreign assets to insure against liquidity shocks, which temporarily shut out the economy of short-term credit markets. Due to a pecuniary externality, individual agents overborrow and hold too little liquid assets relative to a social planner. This inefficiency rationalizes macroprudential policy intervention in the form of reserve accumulation at the central bank to stabilize trade and the real exchange rate. Our model quantitatively matches the depreciation of the real exchange rate and contractions in output, gross trade flows, and foreign reserve holdings during Sudden Stops.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个小型开放经济模型，其中代理人从国际借款并投资于流动性外国资产，以防范流动性冲击，这种冲击会暂时将经济排除在短期信贷市场之外。由于货币外部性，个体代理人相对于社会计划者会过度借款并持有过少的流动性资产。这种低效率为宏观审慎政策干预提供了合理性，即中央银行积累储备以稳定贸易和实际汇率。我们的模型在数量上匹配了突然停止期间实际汇率贬值以及产出、总贸易流量和外汇储备持有量的收缩。
